notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content: [p]Hey! How’s it going?  [/p][p]Eating well? Sleeping in? Folding clothes? [/p][p]That’s so great to hear.[/p][p][/p][p]- Oh, us? Nah, we haven’t been up to much. [/p][p]Well, except for all the work we’ve put into our new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"][u]Blighted[/u][/url]. Check it out![/p][p][/p][p]As you know, we [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2974160/announcements/detail/533226373233248985"][u]announced[/u][/url] Blighted back in June as part of [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9JHPGemT0gI&ab_channel=thegameawards"][u]Summer Game Fest 2025[/u][/url], and we’ve been hard at work on it since. (Thanks for wishlisting it, by the way. It really does help 🙏)[/p][p][/p][p]We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve added a TON of enemies to the game, and are still adding more! Each of them deadly in their own weird and freaky little way.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]It’s hard to believe but we actually built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! And right now we’re in the middle of tearing it all up, choosing the best bits, adding juicy challenges and putting it all back together again.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]Now, it might sound like we don’t have much left to do, but that couldn’t be further from the truth! We’re still fine tuning the gameplay and combat loop to go beyond the standard we’ve established in any of our other games thus far. Blight is getting deadlier, and gnarlier too. Our programmers are working all sorts of technical magic to make Blighted shine, ooze and wriggle. And every new object in the game is another opportunity for our artists to draw up a fresh nightmarish creation to populate the growing world. And Jim Guthrie is still sending us tracks that put shivers down our spines in all of the best ways.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're also prepping the soundtrack from Tales from Space: Mutant Blobs Attack to be released on Steam very soon! As one of our first major releases, Mutant Blobs Attack will always hold a special place in our ears - because the soundtrack by Peter Chapman and Shaun Hatton is SO GOOD. If you ever need a shot of caffeine directly into your earlobes, load up this soundtrack, sit back, and get back up again because your toes will not stop tapping.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLSBqlew1oYLAN1HV9oezPGECMjlVP1r4NB60tS529tzdSypMl_0bJVfLRJZz_hjtCOLy1nLpgeY7kSNurU6ldRLcLNQ3oz2_pudPhbuFnB3ZoxyzqBpNN0xonYoR_d-smP7VDZQ?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]On the more human side, we recently took the team out to get their quarterly quota of exercise by running, jumping, dodging, ducking, dipping, diving, dodging, throwing, shooting (basketball), shooting (gun) and yelling with [url="http://playactivate.com"][u]Activate[/u][/url]. We then gathered for our biggest team photo to date!! (we’re still missing an international co-worker or two, but we’ll get them one day!)[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGWP9bjPXc4TEF92lcb1cSn1rR7NMcd0_by5CbjprrIM9GQYpW25AntKL0Bb19xy4CZGFkhEORf8QcQ8pXc_6JxiaBuTCzExVvUUCiAWpYA4fbJlkbls86-kz4bFPP_1RkQSmY?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Huh. Turns out we have in fact been ‘up to much’! Sorry for all the yapping. As a thank you for listening, we’ve put [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/drinkbox/list/48544"][u]all of our games[/u][/url] on sale on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Catch you later![/p][p]The Drinkbox Team[/p]

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/002999d6b6cc90990cfb62b28377ed799cf7a452.png[/img]

Happy Holidays! 2023 was a relatively quiet year for us as we’ve been heads-down, working on some new ideas… but we still wanted to share some highlights from the past year!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/ba07ac9e7634dbde752899bf0618bf198c826a59.png[/img]

In January we released a free update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/]Nobody Saves the World[/url] which featured Magic Jimmy’s Impossible Dungeon and a new unlockable Dinosaur form. We were overwhelmed with the positive response to this update and loved seeing photos of your statue gardens!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/8f6eee9b4374c296186f877c15cbb034520008e2.jpg[/img]

This year we added some new members to our team including 3D Technical Artist Greg and Junior Programmer Fred. We also welcomed back Animator and Artist Matheus who worked with us on Nobody Saves the World!

Speaking of our team, here are some of their favourite games played in 2023:
[list]
[*] Cass: Nioh, Dragon's Dogma, Remnant 2
[*] Fred: Paradise Marsh, Risk of Rain Returns, Plate Up
[*] Gabby: Zelda TOTK, Baldur’s Gate 3, Dave the Diver, Slay the Princess
[*] Graham: Baldur's Gate 3, Zelda TOTK, Mario Wonder
[*] Greg: Lethal Company
[*] Ian: Time Crisis 4, Cobalt Core, Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days
[*] Josh: Hi-Fi Rush, Mario Wonder
[*] Matheus: Alan Wake 2, Spider-man 2, Elden Ring
[*] Mau: Mario Wonder, Zelda TOTK, Metroid Prime
[*] Mike: Baldur's Gate 3, Armored Core VI, Cyberpunk 2077
[*] Ryan: Dungeons & Dragons (pen and paper)
[*] Steele: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades, Victoria 3, RimWorld
[*] Vlad: Counter-Strike 2, Squad, Spider-Man 2, Armored Core VI
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/45fbd48875f82292a86d5a067a18e4a8b09a6161.png[/img]

Here are some highlights from the past year:

🥇 Nobody Saves the World was nominated for a bunch of awards, including the Canadian Screen Awards, Canadian Game Awards, and Webby Awards. We didn’t win any of these, buuuuut…

🏆 [url=https://jimguthrie.bandcamp.com/]Jim Guthrie[/url] won the Screen Composers Guild of Canada award for “Best Original Score for Games and Interactive Media” for the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack!

💿 Jim also released the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack on a beautiful double vinyl

🐓 We teamed up with [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/drinkbox-studios]The Yetee[/url] to release new Nobody Saves the World and Guacamelee merch, including this [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/drinkbox-studios/products/pollo-power]very good spinning pollo pin[/url]

💖 We partnered with [url=https://limitedrungames.com/]Limited Run Games[/url] to release physical versions of Nobody Saves the World, Severed, and Mutant Blobs Attack (which sold out almost immediately!)

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/56605bcb2d046e74eeb5fd36d2515cf140f33bd5.jpg[/img]

Over this past year we’ve been busy prototyping new stuff, playing with new ideas and styles. We’ve landed on something the whole team is very excited about, something completely new to us that we hope you’ll be excited about too.

We can’t wait to share more when we can, but in the meantime here’s a lil sneaky peek ^

Consider [url=http://discord.gg/drinkbox]joining our discord[/url] to keep updated on the latest news about all our games (including this new one)

- - - 

Thank you for all your support over this past year! We really couldn’t have done it without you and appreciate your support.

Happy Holidays, 
Signed, [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@drinkbox/video/7195583559825034501?lang=en]Matthew DrinkBox[/url]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/73b631387be9db8f8ae622dae5a5d308636b509d.png[/img]

Pssssst, a bunch of our games are ON SALE for the holiday season! These are usually the steepest discounts we do all year, so there’s never been a better time to pick them up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/534550/Guacamelee_2/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/275390/Guacamelee_Super_Turbo_Championship_Edition/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/206370/Tales_From_Space_Mutant_Blobs_Attack/

notes.title: Impossible Dungeon Update
notes.content:
“IMPOSSIBLE DUNGEON” UPDATE NOTES:

- New Dungeon: A carnival themed "endless" dungeon which challenges players to quickly complete increasingly difficult floors under time pressure 
- Doing well in the dungeon rewards players with "tickets" which can be spent to build a large statue containing all of the game's forms
- New "Dino" form, with all new abilities and quests, unlocked by playing the Impossible Dungeon. The Dino form encourages players to swap between different damage types in order to gain damage boosting effects

ADDITIONAL BUG FIXES: 

- Gates at the start of the Frozen Hearth area could incorrectly close behind players
- Using Slime Slide twice quickly in succession could incorrectly make the starting puddle a damage zone
- Health leech was not being calculated correctly for some abilities when in a dungeon with the x9999 damage mod
- “0 mana required” modifier was not allowing some abilities to be performed when the player had 0 mana
- Some enemies would not be hit by turrets projectiles when projectiles were fired at certain angles
- Mechanic's leg animations could break when using arrow flurry
- Players could sometimes get stuck behind a rock in the Whackamelee! challenge room
- Summoning demons from turret deaths did not count towards the Necromancer's "Custom II: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle" quest
- Frozen Hearth level load screen was not properly centered
- Fixed issues with using some wireless / bluetooth controllers to play the game

notes.title: Impossible Dungeon Update OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Today is Nobody Saves the World’s first anniversary! To celebrate, we’re releasing a brand-new Impossible Dungeon update, out today for FREE! 

The update introduces a new carnival themed “endless” dungeon and a new Dinosaur form you can unlock by playing through the Impossible Dungeon.

[previewyoutube=DBAKGAFcfk4;full][/previewyoutube]
Step right up, and see if you’ve got what it takes to brave the challenges of Magic Jimmy’s Impossible Dungeon! Tucked away in a corner of the Alchemist’s Gorge area, players can test their skills on several floors of increasingly tough combat challenges while racing against the clock to try and get through each challenge as quickly as possible. This mode is perfect for Nobody Saves the World players who are looking for an endless combat challenge and a space to test new form combinations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/508a036e82b96a9526d2ee982cb34d9963e32237.jpg[/img]

Conquer the Impossible Dungeon, and be rewarded with the magical Dino Plushy that unlocks the new Dinosaur form! As with all other forms, the Dino comes with its own unique abilities and quests, and can be used throughout the entire game. Doing well in the dungeon will also reward players with tickets that can be used to build a commemorative statue of all the game’s forms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/11e5085c1e307f4a44ef27c76ce7d7fe3530df27.jpg[/img]
[i](Artwork by [url=https://twitter.com/_Mujizik/status/1559515403914825730]Matheus Meneguette[/url])[/i]

To celebrate its anniversary, Nobody Saves the World is today’s Steam Daily Deal for 40% OFF, the game’s lowest price ever!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/ 

Thanks for all your support for Nobody Saves the World! This last year has been an amazing ride, and we couldn’t have done it without you. We hope you enjoy this new update!

[b]– The Drinkbox Team[/b]

notes.title: Nominate Nobody Saves the World for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
It's been an exciting year for us over here at Drinkbox Studios. Way back in January, we released [i][b]Nobody Saves the World[/b][/i], and it turned out to be our biggest launch ever! A huge thank you to everyone who has played the game. (You're the best. YES YOU!)

Since the launch, we've continued to support the game, adding in the highly requested local multiplayer support in April, and releasing the Frozen Hearth DLC in September. Small golf anyone?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/bfdf18a94d4d20af8a20450714334978d0dcf218.gif[/img]

We're still not done with the game (you can expect some news from us in the new year), but in the meantime, we would really appreciate it if you could help us with a nomination in the "Better with Friends" category of the Steam Awards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/a62aa6da1709c7a213127b62b15ef1f9c2b22f95.gif[/img]

To celebrate, we've just put the game on it's deepest discount yet, so if you haven't had a chance to pick it up yet, now could be a good time. 

Thank you again everyone!

- The Drinkbox Team

notes.title: Frozen Hearth DLC AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

[b]The Frozen Hearth DLC for Nobody Saves the World is available now!!![/b]
The Frozen Hearth brings even more form changing and quest completing wizardry along with The Tempering, a mysterious festival that's calling for a new champion!

[previewyoutube=HUjnMN7aE9A;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate its launch we’ve put the DLC on sale for 10% OFF for a limited time:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951590/Nobody_Saves_the_World__Frozen_Hearth/

[h3][u]New Forms and Abilities[/u][/h3]
Don’t let the Mechanic’s wizened looks fool you, they’ve got a couple of gadgets up their sleeve that are sure to make you rethink any [i]familiar [/i]strategies. And small but deadly, the Killer Bee zips around the map striking with devastating precision and fistfuls of empowering honeycombs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/34941acfe78d04a81be9f02ddd68d7cdfa712962.gif[/img]

Mix and match these new abilities with all the forms and abilities you already know and love, unlocking even more game-breaking combos!

[h3][u]A Contest of Champions[/u][/h3]
Take a break from saving the world to compete in The Tempering, a colosseum full of specially designed challenges. Completing challenges is the key to unlocking powerful new forms and abilities! Can you conquer the colosseum and claim the title of the True Being!?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/a62aa6da1709c7a213127b62b15ef1f9c2b22f95.gif[/img]

[h3][u]The Frozen Hearth[/u][/h3]
Travel to the frigidly molten depths of the world. Defeat new enemies and make new friends in this new region located in the planet’s core! I hear that a disgruntled citizen or two might have made their own challenges to better test the quality of a champion… some kind of… small? …golf??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/bfdf18a94d4d20af8a20450714334978d0dcf218.gif[/img]

[h3][u]The Whole Package[/u][/h3]
Save the world with no compromises by getting the base game AND the Frozen Hearth DLC in the Nobody Saves the World Complete bundle, which comes with a 15% discount! Perfect for anyone new to saving worlds.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27016/Nobody_Saves_the_World_Complete/

So what are you waiting for? Jump in and test your mettle now!
[url=https://discord.gg/XXXtbjvx7j]Then join our Discord[/url] to share your victories (and hear about any more updates directly from us!)

Good luck, hope you have fun and try not to get too sweaty!

- Drinkbox Team

notes.title: UPDATES FOR NEW “FROZEN HEARTH” DLC + BUG FIXES
notes.content:
[b]UPDATES FOR NEW “FROZEN HEARTH” DLC:[/b]

- New Level: Added new “Frozen Hearth” underground area to the overworld which contains The Colosseum: a new challenge level that will present the player with various challenges. The new area can be accessed via one of two teleporters, found to the east and west of the Castle. Check the world map for new quest icons to see the exact locations.
- New friends and enemies: a variety of new enemies and friendly NPCs can be found in the Frozen Hearth. Some of these new friends may have some new tasks to complete. Small-golf anyone?
- New Forms: Complete objectives in the Colosseum to unlock the new Mechanic and Killer Bee forms.
- New Summon: In addition to the new abilities of the new forms, completion of objectives in the Colosseum will also unlock a powerful new summon: Lavalarie.

[b]BUG FIXES & NEW FEATURES: [/b]

- Rather than quitting to the main menu, we now attempt to allow the host to continue playing when a client disconnects
- Support Shield enemies could cause some enemies to get stuck in the fear or stunned states when buffing them
- Support Ward enemies would not seek out other enemies to buff if they were next to another support ward enemy
- It was possible for Randy to be killed by the closing spike wall in some cutscenes if he was impeded by money / item drops. He should no longer be impeded by these
- Made the giant turtle’s egg-breaking side quest more colorblind friendly
- Made the Dragon form immune to the “Burn” status effect
- Holy Light ability should now work on the targets in the Archery Range side quest
- Shopkeeper icons were missing in the Jungle Swamp level
- Form customization tutorial now indicates that ACTIVE abilities must be equipped to progress the challenge
- Client walking “dust” could persist on the host if client disconnected
- Soft lock was possible if the player was standing on an active dungeon teleporter and interacted with the dungeon mod sign just inside the dungeon entrance

notes.title: New Update Out Now - Local Co-op and Japanese Language Support Added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re excited to announce that with the latest patch, local co-op has now been added to [i]Nobody Saves the World[/i]! 

To celebrate, we’re putting the game on sale for 10% off, and also offering discounts on all of our older games @ 75% off!

[previewyoutube=_wW4NQOGccc;full][/previewyoutube]
To add an additional player in local co-op mode, just connect a second controller and press a button to join the game. You can also change which control device is assigned to each player in the new “Assign Controllers” screen, accessible from the “Controls” menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/cb3e7d2943d47ef9669e14dfaf42b955e3543227.jpg[/img]

Additionally, full Japanese language support has been added into the game with this update. We’d like to send out a huge thank you to [url=https://www.kakehashigames.com/]Kakehashi Games[/url] for their help preparing the Japanese release.

Finally, this new patch also includes fixes for some minor gameplay issues that were affecting a small number of players - please see the patch notes for more details.

We hope you enjoy it!

- Drinkbox Team

notes.title: Patch Notes for Steam - Apr 13, 2022
notes.content:
New Feature: Local Co-op support added. Change how controllers are assigned using the new Assign Controllers screen, accessed via the Controls menu
New Feature: Full Japanese language support
Performance: Lighting and graphical effects have been updated to help improve performance on slower machines
Performance: Some art pieces with small amounts of alpha have been set to use binary alpha. Other art pieces with large amounts of alpha have been “cut out” to reduce overdraw
Improvement: Added reminder of how to lock direction to the archery range challenge
Improvement: Minor tweaks to text in the opening parts of the game, to improve onboarding of new players
Bug fix: Fix to stop players from entering Secret Corp. dungeon without first opening the Star Door
Bug fix: In multiplayer, familiars could sometimes freeze when the player who summoned them died
Bug fix: Improve the selection of teleporters when the map is at farther zoom levels
Bug fix: Some ability cooldowns could be reset by using quickswap
Bug fix: Quick swapping while using Tempest Barrage ability could cause the player to become stuck in a slow walk
Bug fix: Familiars could sometimes leave a blocking hull behind when they died
Bug fix: Fixed Moletopia dungeon hud popup not appearing in some circumstances
Bug fix: Nostramagus Museum dungeon quest had incorrect icon
Bug fix: Cool Witch’s “!” icon would sometimes not clear after beating her in the race
Bug fix: Plugged several small gaps in level geometry that players could fit into with small forms and potentially become stuck
Bug fix: Fix to Dark Nest arena to prevent second player from dying when spike walls were raised
Bug fix: Fixed Marty Joe tutorial scenes where second player could die on spike walls
Bug fix: Fixed players getting teleported when they changed forms within Octavia’s lab
Bug fix: One player entering or exiting an interior just as the other player initiated a conversation/cutscene could break the cutscene in some circumstances
Bug fix: Improved the way “Boo” ability draws with respect to other objects in the world
Bug fix: Fix for some NPCs being pushed by certain enemy attacks
Bug fix: Dungeon mods text could overlap dungeon title info in some languages
Bug fix: Purchasing all items from the second page of the Shop could cause a crash
Bug fix: Adjusted hulls on the Cauldronator 2600 so that larger forms can get on and off it more easily
Bug fix: Using the “Steele Plated” passive during Laura’s final Knights Guild quest could cause the game to crash
Bug fix: Fixed issue with thieves guild questline becoming incompletable if player died or quit between providing the password and collecting their stars
Bug fix: Fix for “Nobody Saved the World” achievement not popping for some users
Bug fix: Fix for total playtime calculation not being correct in some situations
Bug fix: Fixed possible soft lock in the final Thieves Guild quest
Bug fix: Client was unable to quit the game when certain tool-tips were on screen. They can now open the pause menu to quit in this situation
Bug fix: Blocked off Dark Expanse side quest area once it has been completed
Bug fix: Fix for players becoming permanently blocked from entering the Clank dungeon
Bug fix: Fix for rare crash when fighting the Secret Corp final boss
Bug fix: Fix for potential game freeze when using the teleporter in the Dark Nest dungeon

notes.title: Local Co-op Update Coming April 14th!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We’ve been truly overwhelmed by the positive feedback from you all since Nobody Saves the World launched back in January. Thank you so much for all of the kind words over the past few months. 

Today we’re excited to announce that we’ll be patching in local co-op as a free update to the game on April 14th! That’s right, with this update a second player will be able join your local game session from the comfort of your couch or backup computer chair.

To kick off a local multiplayer session, all you'll have to do is "Press A" on a second controller (or Space on a keyboard) to join in your co-op partner:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171468/f46842e3183e18072acd95664854fbf8e838a3ec.jpg[/img]

We have more exciting news coming soon, so please stay tuned!

- Drinkbox Team

notes.content:

- Added additional logging around network timeouts
- Incremented net version number

notes.title: New Patch: Soft-lock Fixes
notes.content:
This patch should fix some rare issues experienced by a few players:
- Gate staying closed before Gigi after dying at the same time as beating the first Jungle arena
- Triggering the save point near the Jungle Mines before killing the enemies to open the gate, and hence getting stuck behind the gate. Should no longer be possible to trigger this checkpoint
- Fixed a stray checkpoint in the water at the bottom corner of starting which could allow people to get stuck on the wrong side of the rope barrier
